definitions.explanation: A formal meal or feast held to celebrate a happy occasion such as a wedding, promotion, or other milestone. More formal than a casual party.

examples.japanese: {祝宴|しゅくえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{盛大|せいだい}→盛大：13644_seidai⟧な{祝宴|しゅくえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{催|もよお}された→催す：11517_moyoosu⟧。
examples.english: A grand banquet was held after the wedding ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}いた→招く：02425_maneku⟧{祝宴|しゅくえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A celebration banquet was held for the entire team to commemorate the championship victory.

notes: Common collocations: {祝宴|しゅくえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to hold a banquet), {祝宴|しゅくえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{催|もよお}す→催す：11517_moyoosu⟧ (to host a banquet), {祝宴|しゅくえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}かれる→招く：02425_maneku⟧ (to be invited to a banquet). A formal, literary word; everyday speech more commonly uses ⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ or ⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧. Related: ⟦{宴会|えんかい}→宴会：04104_enkai⟧ (banquet — more general, not necessarily celebratory), ⟦{披露宴|ひろうえん}→披露宴：05636_hirouen⟧ (wedding reception — specifically for weddings), {饗宴|きょうえん} (feast — literary).
